classification: A found path is rejected as having no owning terminal; this is not search exhaustion or evidence of physical infeasibility.
source_mechanism: filter_pin_access retains nodes in radius/manhattan preference order. The multi-source result lookup uses binary_search on that non-numerically-sorted vector. It may reject a selected start that is actually a member.
ranked_fixes: Use linear membership for the bounded preference-ordered access vector, preserving candidate ordering.
Sort access vectors numerically after selection; valid membership but changes search tie ordering more broadly.
Add an auxiliary membership set; unnecessary allocation for the default 16-element bounded domain.
minimum_experiment: Deterministic multi-source micro-board with diversified access rings and static seeds disabled; demonstrate unmatched ownership before the fix and legal connected copper afterward. Re-run corrected-rule Tier 0 at the same four-epoch budget.
success_criterion: Remove false unmatched-terminal failures without accepting any previously illegal path. Final tier promotion still requires original-project KiCad DRC.
